name: The Visitor
description: Once a day, at your set time, a stranger arrives at your apartment door in Fracture City. You have 15 minutes. Let them in, talk through the door, lie, help, or send them away. Your decisions accumulate — your apartment fills with the evidence of who you've been. Painterly AI-rendered scenes. Daily ritual.

inputs.description: Optional. Your own Coherence Assessment profile shapes who comes to your door.
Optional. Pre-forged characters can appear as visitors instead of fully procedural ones.

outputs.description: Record of each visit — visitor, your choices, what they wanted, what was left behind.

author: Avner Media
